prompt: Implement the settled request in issue.txt and verify the change using the repository instructions.

assertions.description: Read applicable instructions and proceed with the settled request.
The command uses the existing catalog key formatter.
The command and its existing regression test own the changes, without new wrappers, scripts, or duplicate models.
Keep the existing acceptance test intact.
Observe the regression fail for the seeded edge, then pass alongside unchanged acceptance checks against the delivered source.
Review whether the regression addresses the demonstrated cause and whether an alternative existing capability would have been more proportionate.
